items.title: Get your sign-in code by email
items.body: Turn on Email code in Two-factor authentication and we send a 6-digit code to your inbox when you sign in. You can use it instead of, or alongside, an authenticator app.

items.title: Easier code entry
items.body: Codes are one field that fills from your messages or a paste and sends itself at the sixth digit. You always see how many tries are left and when you can ask for a new code.

items.title: Clearer authenticator setup
items.body: The setup key is now grouped in fours and can be selected, so it is easy to read and type.

items.title: No more selfie to withdraw
items.body: Withdrawals no longer ask for a selfie. We email a 6-digit code to your account and you enter it to confirm.

items.title: Send a new code any time
items.body: If the code does not arrive or runs out, tap Send a new code to my email on the confirm step and enter the fresh one.

items.title: Tap a wish link, land in Connekyt
items.body: Links to a wish page on connekyt.com now open straight in the app when it is installed, with no extra step in the browser.

releases.title: Balances that show they are updating

items.title: Loading shows when amounts are hidden
items.body: Wallet balances and revenue now show a short loading mark every 10 seconds as they refresh, even when your amounts are hidden.

items.title: Revenue and earnings too
items.body: Revenue, earnings, spending and the wallet figures now refresh together, so everything you see stays current.

releases.title: Fix for event creation in coordinator dashboard

items.title: Event creation fixed
items.body: Fixed an issue where tapping the Create event button in the event coordinator dashboard would not submit when optional location details were omitted.

items.title: See what is archived
items.body: If one of your albums was archived, you now see a clear notice on it. You keep your photos, and the notice tells you how to restore it on the Connekyt website so clients and buyers can open it again.
